name: alert
description: Inline alert for status messages with semantic variants (destructive, success, warning, info)
designIntent: Alert communicates status or requires attention. Use it for form errors, success confirmations, warnings, and informational notices. Renders role=alert so screen readers announce it immediately.

props.name: variant
props.description: Semantic style variant; danger is an alias of destructive.

examples.title: Destructive alert
examples.code:
<Alert variant="destructive">
  <AlertTitle>Error</AlertTitle>
  <AlertDescription>Your session has expired. Please log in again.</AlertDescription>
</Alert>
examples.description: Error state with title and description

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Alert for transient notifications
antiPatterns.explanation: Alert is persistent inline content. Use Toast for temporary notifications that auto-dismiss.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Alert for required form validation
antiPatterns.explanation: Field-level errors belong next to the field with aria-describedby. Use Alert only for form-level errors.

accessibility.implementation: role=alert announces the content when it appears
accessibility.userRequirements: Use variant=destructive or its danger alias for errors; screen readers announce it with urgency
Maintain logical heading order in your page

goodExamples: Your session has expired. Please log in again.

compositionRules.relationship: Pair title with description for structured alerts
